carried_set_rule: One model is trained: lstm-gaussian-re, T2's configuration unchanged apart from its id, from scratch on plan configs/phase11/a (seed 226, phase-7 ranges). After training it is validated on seed 217 (tma-g5 --beat against the frozen T2, reference the -g1 IMM); it is carried to G8 if every one of the six point estimates is within its limit. The gate itself is set by a later decision (40) that freezes both T2s by model_digests before the fresh test seed 227 is generated.
change: Phase 11 (SRD Annex C §C.18, owner decisions 2026-11-13): retrain T2's architecture and configuration from scratch on realistic-bearing-error data (generator 0.6.0, configs/phase7-ranges.json), to test whether training on the error helps; G8 with the frozen T2 as the estimator to beat.
rationale: Under realistic bearing error the frozen T2 (trained on white noise) has the most robust range of every estimator (phases 7-10: 1.47 x its clean error against the IMM's 1.82 x), and neither fusion re-tuning nor a bias-state IMM closed the gap to it. Training on the error is the remaining learning step. No forecast of the outcome is made: T2's range advantage is partly robustness the network may keep or lose when trained on the error.
